dropdownSelections.prompt_intent: Create a cinematic nocturnal desert landscape emphasizing stillness, moonlight, stars, and natural silhouettes
dropdownSelections.subject_action: resting silently beneath a bright full moon and dense star field
dropdownSelections.director_style: wide establishing shot with quiet western sci-fi atmosphere
dropdownSelections.background_setting: dark mountain range beneath a starry night sky
dropdownSelections.environment_density: sparse desert vegetation with open sky dominance
dropdownSelections.composition: large cactus silhouette on the left foreground, moon in the upper right, mountains across the horizon, open star field filling the frame
dropdownSelections.lighting_contrast: high contrast between dark silhouettes and glowing sky
dropdownSelections.color_palette: deep navy, teal blue, icy cyan, moonlit silver, black silhouettes

Subject Details: A tall branching desert cactus stands in silhouette in the left foreground
and dry desert brush. The full moon hangs bright in the upper-right sky.
Environment Details: A remote desert basin stretches toward a dark jagged mountain range. The sky is filled with hundreds of visible stars
with subtle atmospheric glow near the horizon.
Composition Aids: Use strong left-right balance: cactus silhouette anchoring the left third
moon placed near the upper-right third
mountain horizon running horizontally through the lower third.
Lighting Effects: Soft blue moonlight washes over the desert floor
creating faint highlights on shrubs and sand while keeping the cactus mostly black against the sky.
Texture & Material Details: distant rocky mountain texture softened by darkness
Post-Processing: minimal noise reduction to preserve night detail
Negative Constraints: no fantasy moons larger than natural scale
